### The Freeness of Grace
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-freeness-of-grace
Passage: Ephesians 2:4-6
Points:
- Spiritual deadness leaves human beings entirely unable to seek or please God on their own.
- In rich mercy, God acts unilaterally to awaken spiritually dead hearts to the glory of Christ.
- Paul interrupts his own thought to emphasize grace because dead people cannot fulfill conditions.
- Salvation is an unconditional and completely free gift, comparable to raising someone from the grave.

### Do You Recognize His Workmanship?
Author: Aaron D'Anthony Brown
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/do-you-recognize-his-workmanship-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Ephesians 2:10
Points:
- Believers are deliberately crafted by God to fulfill good works and a higher purpose.
- Fully growing into God's workmanship requires cultivating a humble, teachable attitude.
- Remembering that we are made in God's image keeps us from feeling hopeless during trials.
- Daily pursuing God and seeking wisdom allows Him to continually refine us as works in progress.
